Subject: Planning: FinLedger demo during staggered DST week

Hi Lucia,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to walk through Redwood inference for FinLedger. A quick scheduling hiccup: the US moves clocks forward on Sunday (Mar 9) and many EU regions don't change until Mar 30, which creates a one- to three-week offset for cross-region scheduling depending on the country. You mentioned EU and APAC stakeholders as well.

To avoid confusion and no-shows, we have two proposals:
- Option A (preferred): Schedule two short (30 min) sessions — one aligned to US mornings (08:30–10:00 PT) and one aligned to EU afternoons (14:00–16:00 CET). We can record and share the recording for any APAC folks.
- Option B: Keep a single session but push it two weeks out (week of Mar 24) so US/EU are back in sync.

I've attached a proposed demo times .ics and a draft mutual action plan (MAP). No commitment — pick what works best and we’ll coordinate follow-ups.

Best,
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: proposed-demo-times.ics (calendar invites for both windows)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (MVP + stakeholders + immediate next steps)
